builds.name: Range Tank
builds.desc:
Place this baby in range of those annoying Reinharts and L!Azuras and be mesmerized at how they just kill themselves like the fools they are.
This set is all around punishing ranged units and those units alone.
with 18 extra points in Def/Res reaching over 44 in total she will eat ranged units like carrots.
to reach her full potential I have her paired um with Camilla and other fliers with Goad Fliers adding 10+Def/Res when close by.
The best feling is when an enemy deals 0 damage over and over again just for you to kill them without breaking a sweat.
